help.head:
Use `n!<command> [flags]` to execute command
Example: `n!sc2fla ui.sc .split_by_name`

notes.title: {{important, emoji}} Syntax notes
flagsDescription: - Flags are mostly optional values ​​that you can provide to bot
- For help message, optional flags are specified in square brackets like `[.flag]`
assetDataDescription: - This is a complex argument that allows you to specify exactly which asset you want to use
fileSearchDescription: - Bot supports regex-like expressions when you using `filename` in `assetData` arguments
- "Starts with" expression should start with **`^`** character
- "Ends with" expression should end with **`$`** character
- Several expressions must be combined with **`&&`** or **`|`** characters
- By default, searches are performed by file names. If you need to search by folders, your main part of the expression should end with **`/`** character
- Example, searches for files that starts with `melodie_`, ends with `.sctx` and stored in `sc3d/` folder: `n!find sc3d/|^melodie_|.sctx$`
- Expressions has concept of modifiers. These are special names starting with @ that modify the output
